items.title: Sabre Wants to Be the Transaction Engine Behind AI Travel Bookings
items.summary: AI platforms could become a new front door for travel bookings. Sabre wants to handle the transactions behind them, even if someone else controls the customer relationship.

items.summary: As merger talk with JetBlue has made a comeback, United is shutting it down, with CEO Scott Kirby still set on a mega-merger with American.

items.title: LA-Area Voters Approve Wave of Hotel Tax Hikes Ahead of 2028 Olympics
items.summary: A dozen cities in Los Angeles and Orange counties raised or updated lodging taxes in recent elections as cities prepare for a surge in visitors during the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

items.title: Turkey Earns More From Fewer Tourists, But Hotels Miss Out
items.summary: Turkey is making more money from fewer visitors, but the gains come from longer stays, not pricier rooms: hotel rates fell in dollar terms. The lowered $65 billion target can be met even if fourth-quarter revenue drops 9%, so clearing it says little about a recovery.

items.title: The Case for Pollution Tourism in India: Sell the Toxic Air
items.summary: India turned its population bomb into a demographic dividend; surely its polluted air deserves the same rebranding.

items.title: Luxury Tours Pushed Deeper Into Amazon As Gateways Urbanize
items.summary: As luxury Amazon trips grow in popularity, operators are having to go further to deliver what they sell: remoteness. Gateway cities, including Brazil’s Manaus, are sprawling, and lodges that once felt remote no longer are.
